# Thrascias
A dense gas giant composed of a large concentration of Frezon.
The pressure on this planet is incredibly high, to the point that typical shuttle walls cannot withstand the lower levels without breaking. In layman's terms, [color=red]going too deep without a specifically built shuttle will likely lead to your demise.[/color]
While there is no surface to land on, orbital scans show structures hovering around the planet. Further inspection shows these structures are likely using the atmosphere as a massive heatsink for data processing to an unknown source.
